about: Milestone NI of ADR 0012, the integration slice of N1b, N2 and N3: the catalogue cases of CF-21 to CF-28 and FX-24/d and /e, recorded on the CE oracle by the fixtures below, which NI wrote and whose runs its exit gate runs on windmill-lite, with control-flow/waits, N2's waits and retries inside containers. Each case is recorded by a run or deferred with a milestone and a reason. CF-23/a and /b put a failure module beside a container, which windmill-lite runs since milestone N3c. A squashed loop runs on the CE image as an ordinary loop, which the catalogue records as CF-25/d; CF-25/a describes a build without the private feature, outside the reference configuration, and is deferred. TestRecordingBatches enforces it.

deferred.reason: the catalogue gives it as CF-V3/a, a child flow failing at its pickup, which N3c's row covers with the CF-V cases

source-derived in the reference's revision SC3 (2026-10-29), and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a branchone aborted at a later transition). Route 3 inside a branchone: the branch job stores the InternalError, while its parent gets the branch's last carried value, 1, as the flow's failed result and as c's previous_result. windmill-lite differs today: a child flow that aborts at a later transition carries the InternalError to its parent (internal/engine, chainingAt), so the parent would get that error; a follow-up of NI implements the carried value

source-derived in the reference's revision SC3 (2026-10-29), and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a branchone aborted at a later transition). The parent's failure module gets the branch's carried value 1 as previous_result, and an error derived from it by JE-17's rule 3 (UnknownError). windmill-lite differs today: a child flow that aborts at a later transition carries the InternalError to its parent (internal/engine, chainingAt), so its failure module would see that error instead; a follow-up of NI implements it

source-derived in the reference's revision SC3 (2026-10-29), and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a branchone aborted at a later transition). retry_if sees the carried value 1 as result and previous_result, with the derived error, so b is retried once. windmill-lite differs today: a child flow that aborts at a later transition carries the InternalError to its parent (internal/engine, chainingAt), so the predicate would see that error and not retry; a follow-up of NI implements it
a raw flow payload: windmill-lite never runs raw submissions (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 6); the harness runs deployed flows by path only

outside the reference configuration: the catalogue gives the case for a build without the private feature (features=oss), not the published CE image, and says it is not recorded; the run later, which cited it, records the CE image instead, as CF-25/d. windmill-lite runs a squashed loop as the CE image does, as an ordinary loop (internal/engine, TestContainerSquash)
the Enterprise Edition's squash (EE): the reference establishes no expectation (Q-CF-11), and the oracle is the Community Edition

source-derived in the reference's revision SC3 (2026-10-29): CE ignores squash on a loop module with a sleep and on a parallel loop, which start no runners, so both of the case's flows give [1, 2]; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (squash and ai parallelism on the CE image). No run of this batch records the case as written: the run control-flow/cf-25/parallel records a squashed parallel loop after a first step, which gives [1, 2] (it records CF-25/d). windmill-lite already runs every squashed loop as an ordinary loop (internal/engine, TestContainerSquash), which gives the case's result
a raw submission, which does not collapse (CF-V5): windmill-lite never runs raw submissions (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 6)

parts.part: the same flow as a preview, which does not collapse and so is not timed
